title: Prediction Space
text: The prediction vector $$\hat{Y}$$ is in the column space of X because it is the projection of Y onto col(X).

title: Residual Sign
text: $$\hat{Y}$$ - Y is the negative of the residual Y - $$\hat{Y}$$, $$so$$ $$it$$ $$has$$ $$the$$ $$same$$ $$orthogonality$$ $$relationships$$.

title: Column Space Check
text: If $$\hat{Y}$$ is in col(X) and $$\hat{Y}$$ - Y is orthogonal to col(X), what is the relationship between $$\hat{Y}$$ - Y and $$\hat{Y}$$?
choices: NOT orthogonal to and NOT in the span of

title: Apply to $$\hat{Y}$$
text: Because $$\hat{Y}$$ lies in col(X), and $$\hat{Y}$$ - Y is orthogonal to col(X), $$\hat{Y}$$ - Y is orthogonal to $$\hat{Y}$$.
